text:
Woman allegedly raped by driver, conductor inside bus in Delhi; accused arrested
The two accused have reportedly been arrested in connection with the incident that took place on May 12.
HT News Desk
A woman was allegedly raped by the driver and the conductor of a sleeper bus inside the vehicle in Delhi, PTI news agency reported on Thursday, citing police sources.
The two accused have been arrested in connection with the incident that took place on May 12, the above-mentioned sources said.
Based on the woman's statement, an FIR has been registered and an investigation has been launched into the matter. The bus has been seized by police, a source said.
More details are awaited.
Meanwhile, another alleged rape case has sparked protests by the Opposition Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), leaders of which were detained by Delhi Police on Wednesday during a demonstration outside Raj Niwas.
AAP's Saurabh Bharadwaj and several other leaders on Wednesday gathered outside Raj Niwas to demand a meeting regarding the sexual assault of a three-year-old girl at school in Janakpuri.
According to AAP, the detention came after the delegation waited for hours outside Raj Bhavan seeking a meeting with Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu over Delhi Police officers for allegedly threatening the survivor child's parents.
Calling the police action inhuman, the AAP Delhi state president Saurabh Bharadwaj said that the LG had time to make reels but not to listen to the public, adding that AAP's fight for justice for the child would continue.
